dedupe_keys.name: reseau routier departemental de l aveyron

description: Réseau routier départemental de l'Aveyron is a dataset listed in Open Data Aveyron, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de l'Aveyron. Réseau routier départemental de l'Aveyron. Coverage: Aveyron. The portal files it under Routes Transports. Its keywords are routes. The portal shows 1,225 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-05-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte version 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-aveyron-fr-portal.
